title.narrative: In 2024, 248,572 children and women benefited from health services supported by UNICEF and the Eritrean Ministry of Health. Services included antenatal, delivery, postnatal, newborn care, immunization, and childhood illness management, with a focus on scaling up services for vulnerable populations, including those affected by drought and Sudanese conflict displacement.
